project_info.theme: Sustainability pack shot emphasizing 100 percent recycled PET bottles

main_subject.detail: A vertical outdoor flat lay of four Cocoon bottles placed on bright grass, each tagged with a bottle-shaped label stating 'CHAI LÀM TỪ NHỰA PET TÁI CHẾ 100% GIẢM NHỰA NGUYÊN SINH', plus a speech-bubble recycling icon near the top left.
main_subject.style: Natural outdoor sustainability flat lay, sunlit eco-awareness product grouping

composition_elements.text: Visible label text includes 'CHAI LÀM TỪ NHỰA PET TÁI CHẾ 100% GIẢM NHỰA NGUYÊN SINH'. Product labels include Winter melon micellar water, Winter melon shower gel, Hau Giang lotus soothing micellar water, and Hau Giang lotus soothing cleanser.
items: Top Left: White speech-bubble icon containing a green recycle symbol over the grass.
Top Right: Amber winter melon shower gel bottle with its large PET tag placed over the shoulder area.
Bottom Left: Large pink Hau Giang lotus micellar water bottle angled diagonally with clear label visibility.
Bottom Right: Pink Hau Giang lotus cleanser bottle and a dark amber bottle cropped at the edges, each bearing the same PET tag.
Center/Background: Dense sunlit lawn texture with products arranged in a loose pinwheel composition.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Sharp natural highlights, crisp grass texture, cheerful eco-campaign freshness

technical_specs.render_style: High fidelity outdoor product flat-lay photography
